notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Vampires.
description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mox Diamond.
Cast Mox Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dominating Vampire.
When Dominating Vampire enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Choose to sacrifice Mox Diamond instead of having it enter the battlefield.
Repeat.
